cohort.direction: close_1429 > open_0930, strictly; flat and DOWN excluded
cohort.atr: Existing frozen causal-map.prepare prior ATR14: arithmetic mean of the last 14 valid prior complete-RTH true-range observations; point-in-time Panama basis only for cross-day indicators; no current-day or future price enters ATR.
cohort.true_range: max(H-L, abs(H-previous_RTH_close), abs(L-previous_RTH_close)), according to the locked context implementation. A missing scheduled RTH session is not silently converted to a valid prior session.
cohort.rollover: Declared point-in-time volume schedule and pre-activation common RTH-close spreads. No outcome-based roll date or hindsight full-sample adjustment. Raw active contract prices for both within-day endpoints.
cohort.membership: Freeze once at14:30. Do not reselect at15:00 or after observing subsequent returns. One observation per selected day.

outcomes.motivation: 15-minute horizon existed before the minute-by-minute inspection. The open anchor is the explicitly selected research anchor, not the older14:59-close anchor.
Post-hoc discovery on consumed data. Known fixed-cohort mean gross approximately5.694444 points, including the inter-bar gap. Not independent evidence.

price_measurement: Long-signed C_end-O_1500 in NQ points and10000*ln(C_end/O_1500) in log-basispoints. Compute each complete horizon directly, never sum separate OC bars without inter-bar gaps.

statistical_plan.estimand: Mean gross long-signed log-bp per eligible fixed-cohort day; mean/median points also reported descriptively. This tests conditional drift against zero, not incremental value over unconditional drift or realized trading profitability.
statistical_plan.null: For each of exactly two horizons, mean gross log-bp equals zero; two-sided p-values, positive estimated effect required for positive-drift support.
statistical_plan.uncertainty: Reuse frozen afternoon_specificity.mean_influence and uncertainty: one score per scheduled day, zero influence rather than a fictitious zero return on nonselected days, Bartlett HAC lags1..5, event-day finite-sample correction and t degrees of freedom n_selected-1. CR1 SE descriptive sensitivity only. No extra inferential family.
statistical_plan.multiplicity: One Holm step-down family of exactly two two-sided p-values, family alpha0.05. Ordered raw p values: adjusted first=min(1,2*p_first), adjusted second=max(adjusted_first,p_second). Missing/uncomputable endpoint retains p=1 placeholder.
statistical_plan.primary_decision: Primary drift support requires positive PRIMARY_15M estimate and Holm2 p<0.05 on the independent registered sample. Secondary cannot rescue a failed primary or become a replacement primary. Statistical support is not HOLDOUT_PASSED trading-edge certification.
statistical_plan.descriptives: Always report both horizons, all exclusions, eligible counts, mean, median and nominal95% intervals. No selecting the better horizon, subgroup, quarter or cost assumption after outcomes are opened.

costs_and_execution.scope: Separate unchanged arithmetic sensitivity only, not a new backtest or primary net-profit hypothesis. NQ multiplier20USD/point. This cost assumption does not prove the open is executable.
costs_and_execution.limitations: No tick/bid-ask/queue/latency evidence for a fill at15:00:00 or exact closing print. No stops, targets, intrabar fill simulation, execution-delay tuning or sizing rule. Actual forward fills, if collected, must be reported separately from research anchors and never substituted selectively.

data_quality.timestamp_limit: Existing OHLCV volume/range patterns support start labels; exact boundary-second inclusion and a vendor-label offset are not independently certified.
data_quality.gate: Before outcomes are unlocked, lock vendor/timezone/label interpretation, raw hashes, calendar, active-contract schedule, rollover availability, quality and shared horizon sample. Require complete09:30-14:29 selection prefix, known ATR14 and all labeled bars15:00-15:14 for the common two-horizon sample. Do not impute, substitute shifted endpoints or drop days by outcome.
data_quality.sensitivity: Any necessary vendor-time normalization must be justified and frozen without seeing new outcomes; a shift chosen to maximize the effect invalidates confirmatory status.

independence.rule: All435 days and both observed horizons are discovery data. No fresh15:00 outcome computation on these days in this registration step.
independence.future_data: Forward observations or genuinely unexamined, nonoverlapping historical data with a declared access/contamination audit. Older history is historical replication, not a forward trial; exclude all overlap with consumed days.
independence.release_gate: No independent run authorized yet. Before any new outcomes are read, a separate immutable addendum must lock the exact test dates OR outcome-independent fixed stopping count, minimum information/power justification, warmup-only periods and exclusions. No optional stopping, repeated significance checks or sample extension after a failure. This candidate specification alone is not a complete released sample plan.

interpretation: No demonstrated Treasury-close cause, independent data certification or validated market edge. No revival or modification of archived ORB/VWAP/London models.
publication: Local registration only in this request. No new GitHub/Vercel publication or future holdout execution authorized.
